title: MiniMax Quota State
description: Persisted 5-hour sliding-window quota state for the MiniMax free tier. Written to ~/.maestro/minimax-quota.json and protected by an fs2 advisory file lock. Unknown fields are rejected by #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] in the Rust struct.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel. Any value other than 1 causes MinimaxQuota::open_with to return an UnsupportedSchemaVersion error.

requests.description: RFC 3339 timestamps (UTC) of every request recorded in the current 5-hour rolling window. Entries older than 5 hours are pruned on every read.

items.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 format, e.g. 2026-05-21T12:00:00Z
